verdict.rationale: Phoenix's documented self-hosting mode keeps all data inside the user's own infrastructure, sends nothing to Arize, and supports full air-gapping, so the vendor cannot use the data for model training. However, the pack contains no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out for hosted use. It also does not address data sent to third-party judge LLM providers. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor no-training commitment or opt-out control, coverage for any hosted/cloud offering, guidance on third-party LLM provider data use, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your data stays entirely within your infrastructure—nothing is sent to Arize and can be fully air-gapped.
